note: Status values for the peer-set controls (vocab/peer-control-set.json) in Profile Lite records and inventory snapshots. Every value is as reported by the institution; the two 'tested' values report the outcome recorded in a full Profile. The Profile Summary (arp-summary/0.3-draft, design only) still uses its own list; aligning the two is open for 1.0.

terms.label: Tested, held
terms.description: The control was tested in a Level 2 or 3 full Profile and held. Only as good as that Profile.

terms.label: Tested, not shown to hold
terms.description: The control was tested in a Level 2 or 3 full Profile and the test did not show it holding.

terms.label: Configured
terms.description: The institution reports the control as configured in the running deployment. Not tested.

terms.label: Documented only
terms.description: The control appears in policy or design documents; no configuration evidence is reported.

terms.label: Absent
terms.description: The institution reports that the control is not in place.

terms.label: Not applicable
terms.description: The control does not apply to this deployment (for example transaction caps where no funds or transactions are permitted).

terms.label: Unknown
terms.description: The institution does not know or has not established the status.
